subject: general
question: World Ocean Day 2025, observed on 8 June, emphasised which of the following themes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wonder: Sustaining what sustains us**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **World Ocean Day** is celebrated annually on **8 June** to raise awareness about the importance of oceans in maintaining ecological balance and promoting sustainable development.
 
• The theme for **World Ocean Day 2025** is **“Wonder: Sustaining what sustains us”**__, emphasizing the vital role oceans play in sustaining life on Earth and the urgent need to preserve them.
 
• This theme highlights the interconnectedness of human well-being and ocean health, encouraging global citizens to adopt sustainable practices and protect marine biodiversity.
 
• It calls for collective efforts by governments, organizations, and individuals to combat challenges like **ocean pollution, overfishing, and climate change.**
 
• World Ocean Day serves as a platform to promote ocean conservation initiatives, advocate for climate-resilient policies, and inspire action to protect marine ecosystems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of the Theme:**

 
 
• The theme “Wonder: Sustaining what sustains us” focuses on fostering a sense of awe for the oceans and recognizing their critical importance in sustaining all forms of life.
 
• The oceans cover over **70% of the Earth’s surface**, regulate the planet’s climate, and provide oxygen, food, and livelihoods for billions of people.
 
• It emphasizes the need to balance human activities with the preservation of marine resources to ensure their long-term viability.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Facing the Oceans:**
 
 
• **Plastic Pollution:** Every year, approximately **8 million tons of plastic** enter the oceans, threatening marine life and ecosystems.
 
• **Overfishing:** Unsustainable fishing practices have led to the depletion of fish stocks, disrupting marine food chains.
 
• **Climate Change:** Rising sea temperatures and ocean acidification due to increased CO2 emissions are causing coral bleaching and biodiversity loss.
 
• **Habitat Destruction:** Activities like coastal development and bottom trawling damage critical marine habitats such as coral reefs and seagrass beds.
 
 
 
• **Global Initiatives for Ocean Conservation:**
 
 
• **United Nations Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development (2021–2030):** Aims to enhance ocean science and promote sustainable management of marine resources.
 
• **Marine Protected Areas (MPAs):** Designated regions in oceans where human activity is regulated to conserve marine biodiversity.
 
• **Global Treaty on Marine Biodiversity:** Negotiated under the UN to protect biodiversity in areas beyond national jurisdiction.
 
 
 
• **How Individuals Can Contribute:**
 
 
• Reduce the use of single-use plastics and participate in beach clean-up drives to minimize ocean pollution.
 
• Support sustainable seafood choices and avoid consuming overexploited species.
 
• Raise awareness about ocean conservation through social media and community initiatives.
 
• Advocate for policies that address climate change and protect marine ecosystems.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Historical Background:**

 
 
• World Ocean Day was first proposed in **1992** at the Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, as a way to celebrate and protect the oceans.
 
• In **2008**, the United Nations officially recognized 8 June as World Ocean Day.
 
 
 
• **Economic Importance of Oceans:**
 
 
• The oceans contribute an estimated **$2.5 trillion annually** to the global economy, supporting industries like fisheries, tourism, and shipping.
 
• More than **3 billion people** rely on marine and coastal biodiversity for their livelihoods.
